scope: Unregistered DLL factory activation; real Windows thread/document/context/range and edit sessions backed by a visible plain-text ITextStoreACP host. Host forwards key/focus callbacks to production sinks; actual Rime IPC and native candidate/menu windows.

checks.name: unregistered production TSF activated with two real text contexts
real composition writes under synchronous text-store lock
space commits Chinese through ITfRange exactly once
explicit English action commits through real TSF range
repeated explicit action cannot duplicate English
application defers actual TSF write grant
deferred owned commit survives later key response
focus switch rejects queued commit in both documents
new focused document owns its composition and commit
native TSF menu opens outside write lock and cancels
focus change closes actual modal TSF menu
service disconnect closes native menu by watchdog
disconnected English action does not replay or insert
all real TSF document writes respected edit locks

limits: Programmatic key/focus callbacks; not Windows routing of an installed TIP or physical keyboard/mouse observations
Native menu open/cancel/focus/disconnect tested; physical selection of its English command remains unverified
No registration, installation, profile activation or input settings changes
x86 isolated service, test-only lexicon; v0.5 full UI and x64 service/package still pending
